subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], This email is to inform you about a change in your upcoming flight itinerary. Your flight has been rescheduled to depart one hour earlier due to unforeseen circumstances. Please review the updated details attached to this email and contact us if you have any concerns or need further assistance. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Sincerely, [Airline Name]
